foundBy: Visual title inspection after headless/browser boot checks passed
issue: Native actor crop bounds ignored local Canvas transforms; all custom translated creatures were invisible.
fix: Track transformed actor drawing bounds in Renderer. Reset pixel color cache after rig restore.

foundBy: Geometry review and focused simulation tests
issue: Adjacent-tier combs could falsely classify an open worker lane as a hive pocket.
fix: Confinement uses current-tier boundaries; brief bank suppression prevents chained contact drops.

issue: Remote one-tick call presses could fall between 10 Hz network sends.
fix: Poll input each simulation tick and latch monotonically increasing call counter until delivery.

issue: The SDK removes a leaver from its player list before the callback, breaking dynamic seat lookup.
fix: Cache immutable player-id to original-seat assignments at connect.

foundBy: Controller/mouse browser checks and focused diagnostic
issue: Generic input activity treated Mouse0 as pad activity and disabled mouse column aiming on spray.
fix: Only new gamepad buttons or meaningful analog changes take ownership from the pointer.

foundBy: Controller-to-local-co-op browser check and native input inspection
issue: Explicitly reassigning a pad to player 2 could be mistaken for a disconnected player 1 pad.
fix: Reset device discovery state when committing an explicit seat configuration.

foundBy: Phone layout screenshot and native Screen code inspection
issue: Native fill scaling clamped to at least 1, which can clip a 640-wide fixed arena on low-density phones; high-density auto also left excessive margins.
fix: Fill supports fractional downscaling; touch defaults to native Fill mode. Canonical collisions remain 640 by 360.

foundBy: Focused phone steering/parcel diagnostic after a weak movement assertion
issue: Touch drag intent lasted only one fixed tick, so acceleration moved a can just a fraction of a pixel per swipe.
fix: Retain the requested touch column across ticks and drive it through normal can motion; deliberate steering cancels clearing. Strengthen the browser distance assertion.

issue: The top HUD obscured part of the pageant crown, and its phase pips overlapped the shield hint.
fix: Lower the float in canonical space and put shield instructions in a separate readable panel.

issue: Long About text scrolled its heading offscreen when native focus moved to page controls.
fix: Split Source Information into short subpages and feedback into two-answer pages with native next/previous and normal back.
